\[\mathbf v(\pi)=\langle0,-4,-4\rangle,\qquad\mathbf a(\pi)=\langle4,0,4\rangle.\]
$a_T=\dfrac{\mathbf v\cdot\mathbf a}{|\mathbf v|}=\dfrac{-16}{4\sqrt2}=\boxed{-2\sqrt2}$, and $a_N=\sqrt{|\mathbf a|^2-a_T^2}=\sqrt{32-8}=\boxed{2\sqrt6}$.
